weakness: After the move to distroless Debian 12 (0.4.4: 258 findings down to 59), the runtime image still carries unfixed findings in libraries the binary needs: libxml2 (1 Critical, 7 High; SAML), zlib1g (1 Critical, CVE-2023-45853), libssl3 (1 High), and Medium/Low in glibc, libxslt and the GCC runtime. None has a fix in Debian 12 at scan time.
remediation: Rebuild on each Debian security update and at every release (the release scan shows what is fixed); track libxml2 and zlib fixes; consider building libxml2/xmlsec from current upstream releases if Debian doesn't fix them.

weakness: Dependency advisories and the image scan run only on push or release, not on a schedule.
remediation: Accepted by the product owner (2026-09-30): dependency advisories and the image scan run when each release is built (scripts/ato/scan, cargo deny, npm audit), not on a schedule. A site that needs scheduled scanning runs scripts/ato/scan on its own schedule.

weakness: Outbound connections (feeds, TAK Server, NATS, Redis, OTLP, OCSP) do not log the resolved destination IP address and port on connect and reconnect.
remediation: Log the resolved remote address (IP:port) on every outbound connection and reconnect, in the access or transport log.
